name: infinite_scroll
prompt: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8765/?scenario=infinite_scroll and extract the title and date for every document item. Scroll down to load more items until all are loaded. A Load more button may appear as fallback. Save each item to save_record with the source URL.

expected.description: 30 records loaded via scroll + load-more, each with title and date non-null.

description: One page that loads more items via AJAX when scrolling. Server serves ?page=N fragments. A Load more button as fallback.
